explanation: Israel's first king, chosen by God through the prophet Samuel. He later becomes jealous of David and tries to kill him.
A young shepherd who becomes an important warrior and leader in Israel. Later he becomes king after Saul and is the founder of the Davidic dynasty.
Saul's son and David's close friend. Jonathan helps David on several occasions and stands up to his father to protect him.
The prophet who anoints both Saul and David as kings over Israel. He is a central figure in the early parts of 1 Samuel.
Saul's daughter and David's first wife. She helps David escape from her father Saul by deceiving him.
The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created heaven, earth, and all life. God guides and protects David through his trials.
